quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a consultancy that helps a hundred-year-old family business modernise without losing the values that built it.
quests.correctAnswer: A business built over four generations is modernised carefully enough to compete today, without erasing the very values a customer walked through the door trusting in the first place.
quests.hint: Begin with what must be protected while everything else changes.
quests.explanation: Naming what must survive change, not just what should change, is what makes a modernisation pitch feel trustworthy to a founder.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch an engineering firm that designs floating platforms allowing coastal communities to build homes above rising water permanently.
quests.correctAnswer: Rather than retreating inland as water rises, a coastal community can build directly above it, permanently, turning a rising sea from a slow eviction into simply a change of foundation.
quests.hint: Reframe the threat itself - eviction becomes a foundation choice.
quests.explanation: Reframing a threat as a solvable design problem, not an inevitable loss, gives a bold engineering idea real, grounded appeal.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a clinic offering a single outpatient procedure that restores hearing for a specific, common form of inherited deafness.
quests.correctAnswer: A single outpatient procedure restores hearing caused by one specific, common genetic cause, giving a child born into silence the chance to hear their own name spoken for the first time.
quests.hint: Anchor the pitch in the specific human moment this makes possible.
quests.explanation: A single, vivid human moment communicates the stakes of a medical breakthrough far better than any clinical description could.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch an investment firm that only backs companies proven to be profitable and genuinely beneficial to society at once.
quests.correctAnswer: Every company in this fund's portfolio had to prove both a healthy profit margin and a genuine social benefit before a single pound was ever invested, refusing to treat the two as a trade-off.
quests.hint: Centre the pitch on refusing the profit-versus-purpose trade-off.
quests.explanation: Refusing to treat profit and purpose as opposites is a confident, differentiated stance in an investment landscape that often assumes they conflict.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a firm that builds custom hearing aids tuned to the specific frequencies an individual musician needs to protect.
quests.correctAnswer: A violinist's hearing is protected at precisely the frequencies their instrument depends on, because a standard hearing aid, built for ordinary conversation, was never designed with a musician's career in mind.
quests.hint: Ground the answer in what a standard product was never designed for.
quests.explanation: Naming exactly what a generic product overlooks is what makes a highly specific, niche pitch feel indispensable rather than small.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a shipping company converting its entire fleet to run on fuel produced from farmed seaweed instead of oil.
quests.correctAnswer: An entire cargo fleet now runs on fuel grown in the ocean rather than pumped from beneath it, cutting emissions without a single ship needing to be rebuilt from scratch.
quests.hint: Lead with no rebuild required, not just the fuel source.
quests.explanation: Emphasising that no rebuild is required removes the biggest practical objection a shipping operator would otherwise raise immediately.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a legal practice specialising exclusively in helping small inventors defend a patent against a far larger competitor.
quests.correctAnswer: A single inventor who can't afford a prolonged legal fight is given the same calibre of defence a large corporation would field, because a good idea shouldn't lose simply for being outspent.
quests.hint: Open with the unfairness of losing purely on budget.
quests.explanation: Naming a specific unfairness, losing purely because of budget, gives a niche legal practice a clear, motivating sense of purpose.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a research programme developing a vaccine platform that can be redesigned for a new virus within days, not years.
quests.correctAnswer: Where a traditional vaccine can take years to develop, this platform can be redesigned for an entirely new virus within days, buying the world time it has never had before.
quests.hint: Start with the dramatic time compression as the whole point.
quests.explanation: A dramatic, credible time compression is the single clearest way to convey why this platform matters more than the science behind it.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a firm restoring damaged farmland so it becomes fertile enough to farm again within a single growing season.
quests.correctAnswer: Land considered too degraded to farm is restored to genuine fertility within one growing season, turning what looked like a permanent loss into simply a temporary, solvable setback.
quests.hint: Reframe the land's status - permanent loss becomes temporary setback.
quests.explanation: Reframing a seemingly permanent loss as a solvable, temporary setback is what makes an ambitious restoration claim feel credible.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a company that manufactures affordable insulin, cutting the price by more than half without changing the formula.
quests.correctAnswer: The exact same formula a patient has always relied on is now manufactured for a fraction of the price, because no one managing a lifelong condition should have to ration a medicine to afford it.
quests.hint: Begin with what shouldn't have to happen - rationing to afford it.
quests.explanation: Naming what shouldn't have to happen gives a manufacturing and pricing story genuine moral clarity, not just a commercial one.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a studio that builds furniture designed to be fully disassembled and rebuilt as a child grows into an adult.
quests.correctAnswer: A crib quietly becomes a toddler bed, then a desk, then a bookshelf, so one piece of furniture grows alongside a child instead of being replaced by four separate ones.
quests.hint: Walk through the transformation across a child's years.
quests.explanation: Walking through a transformation over time makes a clever design idea feel like a genuine, memorable story, not just a feature.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a company developing crop varieties that need significantly less fresh water without sacrificing any yield at harvest.
quests.correctAnswer: The same yield a farmer has always counted on now arrives using a fraction of the water, so a drier future doesn't have to mean a hungrier one.
quests.hint: Anchor the pitch in what stays the same - yield - despite less water.
quests.explanation: Reassuring on yield first is essential, since a farmer's biggest fear about any new variety is a smaller harvest, not the water saved.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a foundation providing full scholarships and mentorship to first-generation university students from low-income backgrounds.
quests.correctAnswer: Tuition, mentorship, and simply believing someone could get there in the first place are given to a student who would otherwise be the very first in their family to attend university at all.
quests.hint: Centre the pitch on belief and mentorship, not just money.
quests.explanation: Naming what's given beyond money, genuine belief and guidance, is what makes a scholarship pitch feel complete, not just financial.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a company building compact nuclear reactors small and safe enough to power a single hospital or factory directly.
quests.correctAnswer: Small enough to fit inside a single hospital's basement, yet powerful enough to run it entirely, this reactor brings reliable, carbon-free power to the one building that can least afford an outage.
quests.hint: Ground the answer in the specific building that can least afford to lose power.
quests.explanation: Anchoring an ambitious technology to one specific, sympathetic building makes an abstract energy claim feel immediately concrete and human.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a company that grows real wood furniture in the exact shape it needs, without ever cutting or joining separate pieces.
quests.correctAnswer: A tree is guided, as it grows, into the exact shape of a chair, so the finished piece has no joints to weaken and no offcuts left behind to waste.
quests.hint: Lead with what's eliminated - joints and waste - by growing the shape.
quests.explanation: Naming what's structurally eliminated, not just what's grown differently, shows precisely why this approach is stronger, not merely more novel.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a research hospital offering a single infusion therapy that repairs heart tissue damaged by a serious heart attack.
quests.correctAnswer: Instead of simply managing the scar tissue left behind, this therapy encourages the heart to genuinely repair it, turning a permanent injury into a temporary setback for the very first time.
quests.hint: Contrast managing a scar with actually repairing it.
quests.explanation: Contrasting management with genuine repair captures a real paradigm shift in how a serious injury could finally be treated.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a firm that helps a long-established brand launch its first genuinely new product line in over three decades.
quests.correctAnswer: Thirty years of customer trust are protected deliberately, not risked, as this brand launches its first new product line in a generation, changing enough to grow without changing what earned that trust.
quests.hint: Open with protecting trust while still genuinely changing.
quests.explanation: Balancing genuine change with protected trust is the central tension any long-established brand faces, and naming it builds real confidence.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a company that captures waste heat from data centres and uses it to warm homes in the surrounding neighbourhood.
quests.correctAnswer: Heat that a data centre used to simply vent into the sky now warms the homes next door instead, turning what was once pure waste into a neighbourhood's own quiet utility.
quests.hint: Start with the reversal - waste becomes a resource.
quests.explanation: A clear before-and-after reversal, waste becoming a resource, is one of the most satisfying structures a sustainability pitch can use.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a firm that restores and re-tunes historic pipe organs so they can be played publicly for another century.
quests.correctAnswer: An instrument silent for decades is patiently restored pipe by pipe, so a piece of music written two centuries ago can still be heard exactly as its composer first intended.
quests.hint: Begin with the composer's original intention being restored.
quests.explanation: Framing restoration as honouring an original intention gives painstaking, technical craftsmanship real emotional and cultural weight.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a diagnostic company whose handheld device can identify a bacterial infection and the right antibiotic within the hour.
quests.correctAnswer: Instead of days spent guessing which antibiotic will work, a single handheld device identifies the exact infection and the right treatment within the hour, when speed can genuinely change the outcome.
quests.hint: Anchor the pitch in when speed genuinely changes the outcome.
quests.explanation: Naming the moment speed genuinely matters is what elevates a diagnostic improvement from convenient to potentially life-saving.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a company that manufactures building insulation entirely from mushroom-based material that fully decomposes at the end of its life.
quests.correctAnswer: Insulation that performs as well as anything synthetic on the market will, decades from now, simply return to soil instead of sitting in a landfill for the next several centuries.
quests.hint: Contrast today's performance with tomorrow's disappearance.
quests.explanation: Contrasting present performance with future disappearance gives a sustainable material both an immediate and a long-term selling point.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a firm that helps a national museum digitise and share its full collection with schools that could never visit in person.
quests.correctAnswer: A school hundreds of miles from the nearest national museum can now walk its full collection in detail, so the accident of geography stops deciding which child gets to see it.
quests.hint: Centre the pitch on what geography no longer decides.
quests.explanation: Naming exactly what geography no longer determines is a precise, powerful way to frame the fairness at the heart of this pitch.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a company producing a fully recyclable smartphone designed to be repaired indefinitely rather than replaced.
quests.correctAnswer: Every part is designed to be opened, repaired, and eventually recycled, so a phone that once had to be replaced every two years can now simply be kept going, indefinitely, instead.
quests.hint: Contrast planned replacement with genuine, indefinite repairability.
quests.explanation: Contrasting a familiar replacement cycle with genuine repairability is a clear, memorable way to explain a fundamentally different design philosophy.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a clinical programme offering a single therapy session format shown to meaningfully help treatment-resistant depression.
quests.correctAnswer: For patients who have tried treatment after treatment without real relief, this carefully supervised approach has shown meaningful improvement where standard options had already, repeatedly, fallen short.
quests.hint: Ground the answer in who this is for - when other options failed.
quests.explanation: Naming precisely who this serves, patients already let down elsewhere, gives a sensitive treatment pitch honest, grounded credibility.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a foundation restoring wetlands that once protected a coastal city from flooding before they were built over decades ago.
quests.correctAnswer: A wetland paved over generations ago is carefully restored, giving a flood-prone coastal city back a natural defence engineers have since spent millions trying, imperfectly, to replace with concrete alone.
quests.hint: Contrast the natural original with the costly artificial replacement.
quests.explanation: Contrasting a natural original with an expensive artificial replacement makes restoration feel like the smarter choice, not just the greener one.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a company building affordable, modular homes that can be assembled by a small crew within a single week.
quests.correctAnswer: A family waiting months for a conventional build instead moves in within a week, in a home built to the same lasting standard, just assembled in days instead of seasons.
quests.hint: Lead with the family's wait, not just the construction method.
quests.explanation: Centring the family's real wait, not the construction technique, is what keeps an impressive engineering claim genuinely human.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a research institute developing a universal donor blood substitute that never requires typing or matching before transfusion.
quests.correctAnswer: In the minutes when a trauma patient can't wait for a blood type match, this substitute can be given immediately, closing the one gap where speed and safety have always been in tension.
quests.hint: Open with the exact emergency moment this resolves.
quests.explanation: A precise emergency moment makes the value of removing a medical bottleneck immediate and viscerally clear to any listener.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a company whose small, patient innovations have quietly reshaped how an entire industry works over twenty years.
quests.correctAnswer: No single announcement made the headlines, but two decades of small, patient improvements have quietly reshaped how an entire industry works, which is precisely the kind of change that tends to last.
quests.hint: Start with patience over spectacle as the real achievement.
quests.explanation: Valuing patience over spectacle is a mature, confident note to end on, and it is exactly what a lasting pitch is built from.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a company built entirely around one simple promise it has never once broken in twenty years of trading.
quests.correctAnswer: Twenty years, thousands of customers, and not one broken promise: sometimes the most persuasive pitch isn't a new idea at all, but proof that an old one was always worth keeping.
quests.hint: Begin with the track record as the whole argument.
quests.explanation: A clean, unbroken track record can be the most persuasive pitch of all, needing no embellishment beyond the plain facts.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch yourself, in one confident sentence, as someone who can now deliver a clear, persuasive idea in under thirty seconds.
quests.correctAnswer: Give me thirty seconds and a reason you should care, and I'll leave you wanting to hear the rest - that's the one skill this entire course was built to give you.
quests.hint: Make the pitch about the skill itself, full circle.
quests.explanation: Closing on the skill itself brings the whole course full circle, turning the final pitch into proof of everything just practised.
